description: Estimate monthly auto premiums across carriers for one driver and vehicle profile, and return the normalized inputs used for the comparison.

age.description: Driver age for the quote scenario.

collision_deductible.description: Collision deductible to use for the estimate scenario.

comprehensive_deductible.description: Comprehensive deductible to use for the estimate scenario.

gender.description: Driver gender value used by the underlying pricing model.

seed.description: Optional deterministic seed for the estimate sample when a caller wants stable repeat runs.

state.description: Two-letter state code for the garaging address or rating state.

style.description: Vehicle trim, body style, or submodel when you want to narrow the vehicle match.

year.description: Vehicle model year when you want the estimate to use a specific car.

zip.description: ZIP code for the driver or garaging location being priced.

name: auto_estimates
title: Auto insurance estimates
